# Ticket 02

## Title

Autopopulate Unit Type and Unit Size

## Description

In the "CONDENSER TYPE" section:
- When a user selects the Condenser Type and the Refrigerant from their dropdowns, we should populate the Unit Type dropdown filtered by the condenser type and the refrigerant that was selected.
- After a user selects a Unit Type, we should populate the Unit Size dropdown filtered by the Refrigerant + Unit Type that was selected

## Acceptance Criteria

When we select the Condenser Type and the Refrigerant we should see the Unit Type dropdown filtered by Condenser Type + Refrigerant selected.
When we select the Unit Type, we should see the Unit Size dropdown filtered by Refrigerant + Unit Type selected.

## Relevant Discussion
The Refrigerants comes from an unitdesign api GET /dropdowns
the attribute to get Unit Type is SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant
for example, we sould filter by the "parent" that contains the refrigerant selected.
  "SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "display": "CU",
      "value": "CU",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "display": "CUE",
      "value": "CUE",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B",
        "R-513A"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },..
]

The attribute for Unit Size is SDCommonUnitModelSizes
for example, we sould filter by the "parent" that contains both the refrigerant and the Unit Type selected.
	
"SDCommonUnitModelSizes": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "display": "101",
      "value": "101",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B",
        "CU"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },
    {
      "id": 1,
      "display": "103",
      "value": "103",
      "parent": [
        "R-410A",
        "R-454B",
        "CU"
      ],
      "isActive": true
    },...
]

interpreterResult.requirementSummary: When a user selects a Condenser Type and Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown should be populated and filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant. After a Unit Type is selected, the Unit Size dropdown should be populated and filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
businessRules: If a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, then the Unit Type dropdown must be populated with entries whose parent includes the selected Refrigerant (and the selected Condenser Type) and displayed to the user.

If a user selects a Unit Type (after selecting Condenser Type and Refrigerant), then the Unit Size dropdown must be populated with entries whose parent includes both the selected Refrigerant and the selected Unit Type.
The data for Unit Type options is retrieved from the unitdesign API endpoint GET /dropdowns, using the attribute SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant.
The data for Unit Size options is retrieved from the unitdesign API endpoint GET /dropdowns, using the attribute SDCommonUnitModelSizes.
developerConsiderations: Implement API call to GET /dropdowns from the unitdesign service to obtain SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant and SDCommonUnitModelSizes collections.
Filter SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries by checking that the selected Refrigerant (and Condenser Type) appear in the entry's parent array.
Filter SDCommonUnitModelSizes entries by checking that both the selected Refrigerant and selected Unit Type appear in the entry's parent array.
Update the Unit Type dropdown UI immediately after Condenser Type and Refrigerant selections.
Update the Unit Size dropdown UI immediately after Unit Type selection.
ambiguities: The ticket does not specify whether entries with isActive:false should be excluded from the filtered dropdowns.
It is unclear how the selected Condenser Type is represented in the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant data for filtering, as the example only shows parent refrigerants.
The behavior when no entries match the filter criteria (e.g., empty dropdown) is not defined.
The case sensitivity or exact matching rules for comparing selected values to parent array values are not defined.
